fever.name: Fever
fever.overview: Fever is a syndromic presentation shared by dengue, malaria, influenza, COVID-19, typhoid and chikungunya. The right test depends on geography, exposure history and symptom timing.
fever.workflow: Travel/exposure history → select pathogen tests → rapid antigen/serology → confirm by PCR or microscopy where needed.

chest-pain.name: Chest Pain
chest-pain.overview: Chest pain raises acute coronary syndrome. Cardiac biomarkers — troponin first, with CK-MB and myoglobin as adjuncts — support diagnosis; D-Dimer excludes venous thromboembolism.
chest-pain.workflow: Serial troponin + ECG → diagnose myocardial infarction (rise/fall pattern) → rule out pulmonary embolism with D-Dimer.

suspected-hepatitis.name: Suspected Hepatitis
suspected-hepatitis.overview: Jaundice or elevated liver enzymes raise viral hepatitis. Screen HBsAg + anti-HCV; HAV IgM and HEV cover acute presentations.
suspected-hepatitis.workflow: Screen HBsAg + anti-HCV → confirm active infection (HBV DNA / HCV RNA) → acute markers HAV IgM / HEV.
suspected-hepatitis.confirmatory: HBV DNA / HCV RNA molecular testing.

pregnancy.name: Pregnancy & Fertility
pregnancy.overview: Reproductive hormone tests support pregnancy detection and fertility tracking across retail and clinical channels.
pregnancy.workflow: hCG for pregnancy detection; LH surge for ovulation timing; fFN/iGFBP-1 for preterm-risk stratification.

workplace-screening.name: Workplace Drug Screening
workplace-screening.overview: Workplace drug testing screens for common drugs of abuse in urine, with any presumptive positive confirmed in the laboratory.
workplace-screening.workflow: Screen with immunoassay → confirm presumptive positives by GC-MS/LC-MS.
